region: TTR and modern type theories: scoped comparisons
summary: At a fixed TTR model, induces an MTT noun type and erases ptype witnesses. Proves only a man-runs inhabitation correspondence. Distinct well-typed records have the same subject projection, which therefore has no inverse.

sources.citation: Cooper, R. (2023). From Perception to Communication. OUP.
Chatzikyriakidis, S. & Luo, Z. (2020). Formal Semantics in Modern Type Theories.

definitions_mapped.source: A2-A3 versus CL20 CN types and weak existential
definitions_mapped.note: Model-relative subtype plus existential witness erasure.
Equivalence of these two propositions, not frameworks, type identities or witness spaces.

theorems.name: record_to_mtt / mtt_to_record_inhabited / fixed_model_inhabitation
theorems.source_claim: Model-indexed inhabitation correspondence on one construction.

theorems.name: LossOfInformation.subject_projection_loses_witnesses / LossOfInformation.no_inverse_from_subject
theorems.source_claim: The subject projection is not injective and cannot reconstruct the original witness record.
